summary: NHTSA noted AMC was the only manufacturer to raise the muffler issue and stated that if more complete substantive data were provided the problem could be addressed, but did not envision it as a problem for MY 1979.
text:
Analysis. No market penetration of diesel engines in trucks in MY 1979 was included in the preparation of the fuel economy standard. Therefore, no consequential environmental impact was anticipated for MY 1979. NHTSA

does not recommend removal of sound deadening materials but recognizes that such action, if taken, would result in increased noise levels. Since the draft EIS asked for comments on this matter and potential problems were indicated, future AFES's will consider the noise level problem in depth as the noise producers indicated by FEA, Ford, IH, and AMC are included in the scenarios for future AFES's. AMC was the only manufacturer to raise the issue on mufflers. If more complete substantive data is provided, the problem, which may be general to all motor vehicles, can be addressed. NHTSA does not envision this to be a problem for the MY 1979 AFES.
